name: hermes-agent-runtime
description: Provenance pin for the on-host Hermes agent/gateway runtime that OpenBurnBar vendors as compiled bytecode (gateway/, plugins/, tools/, hermes_cli/, tui_gateway/, agent/). Security remediation C-5: makes the most security-sensitive host-side component auditable + verifiable instead of opaque .pyc.
hashDefinition: sha256 over the sorted list of 'path sha256(blob)\n' lines for every *.py file under vendoredSubtrees at pinnedCommit (see scripts/ci/verify-vendored-agent-source.sh).

pendingHardening.reason: CLEARED 2026-06-10. Security remediation C-4 (agent command-guard hardening: secret-read/exfil gating, fail-closed tirith, smart-mode escalation, opt-in subprocess-env hardening M-7) is now MERGED into the pinned commit bdb830070 (C-4 commit 35bbc2c61 cherry-picked onto the L2 PoP signer 005cf0d86; no file overlap). Verified: the C-4 guard suite tests/tools/test_secret_exfil_guard.py passes 40/40 (secret-read/exfil flagged, benign commands not flagged, tirith fail-closed default asserted, secret categories never smart-approvable, env-secret heuristic); the C-4-touched modules (tools/approval.py, tools/tirith_security.py, tools/environments/local.py) import clean. tirith now fails CLOSED by default (was fail-open).
pendingHardening.remainingOperational: The pinned commit bdb830070 is a LOCAL cherry-pick on the fork checkout; push the fork branch ajnunezg/burnbar-gateway-e2ee to origin so CI fetching the pin succeeds (verify-vendored-agent-source.sh resolves the commit from the checkout, which is sufficient for a local/dev build but the protected-branch CI needs the commit on origin).

auditNote: The shipping product currently vendors this runtime as .pyc with the .py source gitignored, so the AGPL corresponding-source archive (scripts/create-corresponding-source.sh) does NOT contain it. C-5 closes that by pinning the exact source commit + hash here and verifying it in CI (verify-vendored-agent-source.sh). For full reproducibility, the corresponding-source archive should also bundle the pinned source tree.
